derived_from: spec 045 US3.1, FR-021 (one read pass, one mutation)
name: board-github-set-mapped-and-written

seen.body: {"query": "query BoardOfUser($login: String!, $number: Int!, $field: String!) { user(login: $login) { projectV2(number: $number) { id title url closed field(name: $field) { ... on ProjectV2FieldCommon { id name dataType } ... on ProjectV2SingleSelectField { options { id name } } } } } }", "variables": {"login": "me", "number": 1, "field": "Status"}, "operationName": "BoardOfUser"}

{"query": "query ItemOnBoard($url: URI!, $field: String!, $after: String) { resource(url: $url) { __typename ... on Issue { id number url title state projectItems(first: 50, after: $after) { nodes { id project { id } fieldValueByName(name: $field) { ... on ProjectV2ItemFieldSingleSelectValue { name optionId } } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } } ... on PullRequest { id number url title state projectItems(first: 50, after: $after) { nodes { id project { id } fieldValueByName(name: $field) { ... on ProjectV2ItemFieldSingleSelectValue { name optionId } } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } } } }", "variables": {"url": "https://github.com/o/r/issues/5", "field": "Status", "after": null}, "operationName": "ItemOnBoard"}

{"query": "mutation BoardSet($project: ID!, $item: ID!, $field: ID!, $option: String!) { updateProjectV2ItemFieldValue(input: {projectId: $project, itemId: $item, fieldId: $field, value: {singleSelectOptionId: $option}}) { projectV2Item { id } } }", "variables": {"project": "PVT_1", "item": "PVTI_5", "field": "PVTSSF_1", "option": "OPT_REVIEW"}, "operationName": "BoardSet"}
